{{Quote|Name and rank!"<br />"My name is Luca&hellip; My rank&hellip; ''Um''&hellip; I dunno? That's my ship, the ''Faithless'', so I guess I'm the captain.|Captain [[Holt (Executor captain)|Holt]] and Luca|<ref name="TWODV" />}}
'''Luca''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who operated as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] associated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Luca, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period of the ascension of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], Luca had a toy [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] he used to play with, imagining he was a powerful warrior the boy could idolize. However, later a new toy came along and Luca cast the toy soldier aside, almost forgetting about him over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, Luca had become a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and [[Captain/Legends|captained]] his own [[Starship/Legends|ship]], a [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] named the ''[[Faithless/Legends|Faithless]]''. He flew supply missions for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Wolf Squadron]], which ambushed Imperials near [[Annamar]]. When the Rebels had [[Ambush on the Corellian Trade Spine|stolen]] an important piece of the [[Death Star II/Legends|new Death Star]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was sent to retrieve it. When the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] arrived at Annamar, Luca's ship was intercepted by the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="TWODV" />

Luca found himself engulfed in a situation similar to his early childhood day dreams, as he was caught and then [[Battle of Annamar|led]] by a [[Sith warrior|warrior]] on a secret route to a Rebel base on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] Annamar. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, with all his power, but bound to the will of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], reminded Luca of him and his toy soldier. Luca alternated between helping and hindering the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in his mission, both causing the deaths of all his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]], as well as helping Vader fight off a decades-old [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] and leading him to the well-defended base, which the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] decimated. At the moment of victory, Vader contemplated [[Death/Legends|killing]] Luca, as he had outlived his usefulness, but spared the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] life, leaving him on the planetoid as he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the stolen [[Imperial cargo ship|cargo ship]] off-world.<ref name="TWODV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Luca was created by [[Tom Taylor]] for the story [[Star Wars Adventures: The Will of Darth Vader|''The Will of Darth Vader'']], which was the fourth volume of the [[Star Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperbacks]]. In the story, Luca was drawn by [[Brian Koschak]].
